raw_segments.text: In another moment, I was within that apartment. There was every article of furniture looking
just as it did on the morning I was first introduced to Mr. Broccolihurst. The very
rug he had stood upon still covered the hearth. Glancing at the bookcases, I thought I could
distinguish the two volumes of Bewick's British Birds occupying their old place on
the third shelf, and Gulliver's Travels, and the Arabian Nights' range just above.
The inanimate objects were not changed, but the living things had altered past recognition.
